name: bracket
title: Bracket bench: optimised bracket
description: Bracket B (and C, the variant printable): the stiffest bracket of the same mass the optimiser finds for the bench's load (problems/bracket.json); for C, only what prints without supports standing on its back plate.
orientation: Standing on its back plate, as optimised. 100% infill, 0.2 mm layers, the same filament as the other brackets. Standing up, even B is almost self-supporting: both B and C have about 100 mm² of small faces a little past 45° (from smoothing the cubes into a surface). Most printers bridge them; if yours doesn't, let the slicer support them.

problem.rule: The optimisation problem: free, or (bracket:printable) printable without supports

target.rule: Every bracket's volume: the same share of the envelope
target.label: Volume

smooth.rule: Segments in each round boss and hole
